summary: Adrian Hall is presented as an American theatre director whose bold style, described by the New York Times, placed his work within the first- and second-generation regional theater movement. The note records his founding leadership of Trinity Repertory Company in Providence, Rhode Island (1963-1986) and his tenure as Artistic Director of Dallas Theater Center in Dallas, Texas (1983-1989). It states he brought major and divisive change to both institutions.
one_line: Adrian Hall was an American theatre director who founded Trinity Repertory Company and led Dallas Theater Center.
key_facts: Adrian Hall is an American theatre director.
The New York Times described the directing style of Adrian Hall as "bold."
The work of Adrian Hall was considered part of the first- and second-generation of the regional theater movement.
Adrian Hall was the founding Artistic Director of the Trinity Repertory Company in Providence, Rhode Island.
Adrian Hall served as Artistic Director of Trinity Repertory Company from 1963 to 1986.
Adrian Hall served as Artistic Director of Dallas Theater Center in Dallas, Texas from 1983 to 1989.
Adrian Hall is considered to have created major and divisive change within Trinity Repertory Company.
Adrian Hall is considered to have created major and divisive change within Dallas Theater Center.
